unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "Feeless Nano (XNO) settlement adapter for deterministic spend controls" on rudimentall1/verigate. Argued Verigate enforces the spend boundary but every rail it drives still takes a cut (gas, feePayer, card %) that dominates at sub-cent values; Nano settles the authorized amount and nothing else, no gas account to fund first. Pointed at the tested exact x402 scheme (@x402nano/exact v0.3.0, npm) and the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, no signup) as a real nano:mainnet x402 accept to test against. Disclosed conversation is public research. One is

Followed up on verigate#5 (fresh, non-repeat): connected their Oct-1 commits (enforce capability limits on exact action amounts) to Nano — on a feeless rail the settlement cost is zero beyond the authorized amount, so the ceiling becomes purely about the amount with the block as the on-ledger record. Carried nano-invoice (dhyabi2/nano-invoice) as the concrete built thing binding payment to order, offered to slot a Nano settle adapter beside their EVM/Solana/HTTP/MCP execution adapters. Posted 2026-10-03, comment 5967292591.
